text:
olivia: Heads up — customer ran the quickstart and the first chat call returned 200, but immediately after the embeddings call returned 403 with reason provisioning_flag_mismatch. They were confused because the console shows the workspace as "active".

olivia: curl (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":["test"]}'
```

olivia: Response: 403 {"error":"forbidden","reason":"provisioning_flag_mismatch","message":"workspace provisioning not compatible with embeddings service","help_url":""} — no help_url which made support hand-holding longer.

ken: That's a newish check. Embeddings backend requires workspace to be flagged for "vector-enabled" during provisioning; chat can run against the fallback sandbox. If flags are out-of-sync you get that 403.

maya: SDK currently treats 403 as terminal, but our quickstart shows a spinner because the sample app retries on network failures and keeps the UX ambiguous. We should short-circuit and show a banner explaining provisioning flags mismatch.

support_bot: Recommended immediate workaround: workspace owner re-run provisioning toggle in console (Workspace -> Settings -> Features -> Enable embeddings) or create a new dev workspace that has vector-enabled. Filed ticket SUP-9211 with logs.

sdk_lead: Two follow-ups: 1) add a typed ProvisioningError in SDKs when reason==provisioning_flag_mismatch and include help_url if present; 2) quickstart preflight should call /v1/onboarding/features and short-circuit demos if embeddings not enabled.

olivia: Also, can we make the API include help_url by default for provisioning errors? Support spent extra time giving customers exact console path.

infra_ops: Deployment wrinkle: feature flag propagation has a ~10s window after a workspace update where backends disagree. That likely explains why customer toggled in console but still saw 403. We should add eventual-consistency guidance to the UI and API.

ken: Good call. Short-term: have the API return header `Retry-After: 5` for provisioning_flag_mismatch for better SDK messaging. Longer-term: surface a deterministic staging event so quickstarts can poll a /status endpoint.

maya: SDK changes: treat provisioning_flag_mismatch as non-retriable for immediate user-visible errors, but if header Retry-After present, expose that field so client can prompt "try again in N seconds". I'll open node#5902 + python follow-up.

olivia: Customer fixed it by re-enabling the feature and waiting ~15s — embeddings then worked. Leaving runbook note: 1) If chat ok but embeddings 403 provisioning_flag_mismatch -> ask owner to enable embeddings feature and wait up to 30s. 2) Quickstart should check features at startup.

support_bot: Added runbook snippet: https://console.redwood.ai/onboarding-runbook#provisioning-mismatch. Tagging @support.

sdk_lead: I'll prioritize SDK error class and help_url plumbing. Adding tests to ensure error serializes help_url and Retry-After header surfaces in SDK error.meta. ETA: 48h.

infra_ops: I'll add a short blurb in the console about eventual consistency after toggling features. That should reduce confusion.

olivia: Thanks team — customer unblocked. Closing ticket SUP-9211 and leaving a doc PR request to docs squad. :white_check_mark:
